svg.title: The hash-chained audit log
svg.desc: Each audit entry stores the previous entry's hash and an ML-DSA signature; editing one entry breaks the chain from there on.

text.font-family: ui-sans-serif, system-ui, 'Segoe UI', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: entry hash = SHA-256 of the entry's contents, including the previous entry's hash.

text.font-family: ui-sans-serif, system-ui, 'Segoe UI', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Edit entry 2 (red, as an example) and its hash changes, the next entry's 'prev hash' no longer matches, and its signature fails.

text.font-family: ui-sans-serif, system-ui, 'Segoe UI', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: The last entry seals the study: it records study SHA-256 6e6ab6cc037600a4... and is signed too.

svg.text: hashes shown are the first 12 characters of the real entries in public/data/audit.jsonl
